d01: Every drop starts with a blank sketchbook, and a guess. You know L.A. loves streetwear. Everyone does.
d02: The real question is which kind of streetwear L.A. loves, and isn't getting.
d03: Ayto answers that before you design a thing.
d04: Tell it what you're making, and where. A streetwear drop in Los Angeles.
d05: It plans its own reads on Clue's taste graph: what L.A. loves more than the U.S., and more than Houston, Phoenix and Philadelphia.
d06: Visual arts. Skate punk. Alternative dance. L.A. ranks them in its top twelve. The rest of the country? Not even in its top thirty.
d08: Then it reads the look: unique silhouettes, high fashion, artisanal. Silk and leather, three times the country's share. Not polished. Not colourful.
d09: Your own AI writes the drop into that gap: Sunset Static. Four styles, a palette, the labels to study, and the first cities to launch in.
d10: Every name opens the Clue request it came from. Ask the same AI without Clue: two of ten names trace.
d11: Then see it: every style on a mannequin, in three D, in the drop's own colours, with its print drawn for it.
d12: Same engine, any format: a crime film in London, a reel in Las Vegas, a live music night in Chicago, an indie game in Seattle, a café in Austin.
